issue.name: vanish_mid_move
issue.detail: visible extent 0.75 on f27, gone on f28: it pops off while still moving instead of finishing.
issue.fix: Change the easing of the SCALE_XY key at 1 s from cubic:0.7,0,0.84,0 to cubic:0.45,0,0.55,1: the last visible frame then shows 0.08.

issue.name: pop_in
issue.detail: appears on f31 already at 75 % of its size (75 px in one frame) instead of growing in.
issue.fix: Change the easing of the PATH_TRIM_END key at 1.1667 s from cubic:0.16,1,0.3,1 to cubic:0.65,0,0.35,1: its first visible frame then shows 4 %.

issue.name: concentrated_step
issue.detail: 69 % of a 6-frame move (cubic:0.7,0,0.84,0) lands in one frame: 137 of 200 px, with blur 0.
issue.fix: Change the easing of the key at 1.5333 s from cubic:0.7,0,0.84,0 to cubic:0.45,0,0.55,1: its largest frame then carries 28 %.

issue.name: strobe
issue.detail: moves 200 px in one frame on f62 with blur 0 (fast from f61 to f65).
issue.fix: Blur the fast frames: effect:0:RADIUS (first give it a LAYER_BLUR of radius 0 with figma_set_effects) peaking at about 13 on f62, back to 0 before it must read sharp [C-243].

issue.name: blur_off_speed
issue.detail: its fastest frame f80 (148 px) has blur 0, but the blur peaks at 8 on f78: the blur is out of phase with the speed.

issue.name: one_frame_extreme
issue.detail: SCALE_XY goes 1.05,1.05 → 1.1,1.1 → 1.0506,1.0506 on f38–f40: the extreme is on screen for one frame, a cusp instead of an accent.
issue.fix: Hold the extreme for 2–3 frames (repeat its value in a key at 1.3667 s), or ease into and out of it.

issue.name: arrival_not_held
issue.detail: arrives on f20 with 49 % of its travel in the last frame, and the arrived state is on screen 1 frame.
issue.fix: Land 3 frames early and hold (the 0.1,0.1 key at 0.5667 s), or decelerate into it (cubic:0.45,0,0.55,1: 2 % in the last frame).

issue.name: no_stagger 1
issue.detail: 3 siblings start the same TRANSLATION_Y move on f30: "no_stagger 1", "no_stagger 2", "no_stagger 3". They read as one block.
issue.fix: Stagger them by 2 frames or more each, in reading order [C-242].

issue.name: unrendered_extreme
issue.detail: the SCALE_XY extreme 1.3,1.3 at 1.0167 s sits 0.5 of a frame off the grid, so no frame shows it.
issue.fix: Move the key to 1.0333 s, a whole frame.

issue.name: easing_census 1
issue.detail: 2 layers overshoot on a stock back or spring easing: "easing_census 1", "easing_census 2". Stock overshoot reads as a preset.
issue.fix: Key the overshoot by hand on the one accent that earns it (a key past the target, then a settle).

issue.name: hold_easing
issue.detail: HOLD into 0 at 1 s: Figma's own sources disagree on which side of the segment the jump lands [C-189].
issue.fix: Use a cut pair: @0.975 1 LINEAR · @0.995 0 LINEAR switches on f30 exactly [C-240].

issue.name: beat_offset
issue.detail: the punch starts on the beat (f72), so the beat frame shows nothing and its peak lands 2 frames late (f74).
issue.fix: Start it 2 frames earlier so the peak lands on f72: move its keys by −0.0667 s.

issue.name: read_time
issue.detail: "three little words here" (4 words) is fully readable for 0.5 s in all; it needs 1.2 s.
issue.fix: Hold it opaque, still and sharp for 36 frames or more, or cut words.

issue.name: rest_state_hidden
issue.detail: its resting opacity is 0, so figma_export_node renders nothing for it.
issue.fix: Check it with figma_export_video frames, or rest it visible and hide it with keys.

issue.name: timeline_end
issue.detail: 1 key after the timeline's end (4 s) never play: TRANSLATION_X @4.5.
issue.fix: Lengthen the timeline (figma_set_keyframes timelineDuration) or move the keys inside it.

issue.name: roundcap_zero_trim
issue.detail: a round-capped stroke at zero length is visible on f0–f60: the caps paint a 8 px dot.
issue.fix: Guard it with OPACITY: 0 while its length is 0, switched on by a cut pair on the frame the draw starts [C-240].

issue.name: brand_late
issue.detail: "brand_late" is first fully visible at 3.5 s (f105); the brief wants it by 3 s.
issue.fix: Show the brand fully by 3 s, even small, and let it grow later [C-235].

issue.name: cta_short
issue.detail: "cta_short" is readable for 1 s at a stretch; a call to action needs 2.5 s.
issue.fix: Land the call to action earlier and hold it still for 75 frames or more [C-241].

issue.name: first_key_late
issue.detail: OPACITY has no key before 1 s, where it starts at 0 while the layer rests at 1: what Figma shows before a first key is undocumented [C-191].
issue.fix: Add a key at t = 0 with the value it should show there (0 to start as keyed).

issue.name: clamped_morph
issue.detail: WIDTH and HEIGHT move on different curves while the corner radius is at least half the short side: on f1 it is 64.5 × 48.8, a stadium rather than a circle [C-196].
issue.fix: Key WIDTH and HEIGHT with the same times and easing (or animate SCALE) while it must read as round.

issue.name: figma-mcp check_motion stillness (delete me)
issue.detail: nothing on screen moves faster than 1 px per frame on f21–f50 (1 s); the fastest is "mover" at 0 px per frame.
issue.fix: Keep something alive through it (a drift of 2 px per frame or more, or a staggered settle), or pass the span in `holds` if the stillness is the point.

issue.name: figma-mcp check_motion stillness (delete me)
issue.detail: frame 0 shows only the background: every layer is hidden or at zero size.
issue.fix: Open on something already on screen and already moving: start the first move at t = 0, or put the first layer in place at frame 0.

issues.name: card
issues.detail: a LINEAR TRANSLATION_X move of 150 px over 60 frames starts or stops at full speed on screen: it reads as mechanical.
issues.fix: Ease it (for example cubic:0.45,0,0.55,1), or keep LINEAR for drifts and cut pairs.
